text:
claire: FYI - NorthBridge onboarding health flagged tail latency on their search route (/api/search/top). Renewal check in 12 days. We need an evidence bundle + draft email with a provisional credit calc.
rob: can you drop the SLOs and the last-7d numbers? i'll prepare the calc template
claire: SLA: 99.95% uptime. SLO: 95% requests < 160ms for /api/search/top. Last 7d: uptime 99.94%, p50=45ms, p95=340ms, p99=720ms. Breach pattern: p95 > 160ms on 3 days (2 business days).
evan: contract trigger = credit if p95>160ms on >1 business day in rolling 7d. We'll need: day-by-day timeseries, top traces for slow tails, autoscale events, and token/request counts per day.
maya: ops initial: looks like cache churn during nightly batch jobs plus one deployment spike. i'll pull cache eviction logs and deployment timeline. Recommend enabling prefix caching canary + one prewarmed replica for 24h.
rob: draft provisional credit formula i'll use: (breach_days / 7) * monthly_commitment * credit_rate. Need requests and avg token size in breach windows to calculate exact credit amount.
claire: customer-facing plan: 1) short 1-paragraph explanation, 2) what we did (canary + suggested synthetic run), 3) provisional credit calc + how we calculate, 4) timelines and next steps. Deadline: 36h for CSM review.
evan: commands i'll run to gather traces/metrics:
```
redwood metrics export --service inference --route "/api/search/top" --since 7d --agg p50,p95,p99,uptime --by day > northbridge-metrics.csv
redwood traces query --route "/api/search/top" --filter "latency>250" --limit 25
redwood infra events --since 7d --filter "cache_eviction OR deploy" > northbridge-infra.log
```
maya: i'll schedule prefix cache canary at 01:30 UTC tonight and spin up a warm replica for 24h. will post 6h snapshot and 24h summary. low-risk change.
legal-bot: automated: Reminder - use "provisional" language in external comms. Credits subject to final verification and audit. Include CSVs, trace IDs, and incident ticket.
slo-bot: automated: 2026-01-15T05:10Z - p95 exceeded 160ms on 3 days in rolling 7d. Incident ticket CS-5019 opened: https://redwood.internal/incidents/CS-5019
rob: i'll produce two credit scenarios for the draft: (A) no remediation applied, (B) remediation reduces breach days -> adjusted credit. also include a plain-language FAQ about tails and warmup.
claire: can we ask NorthBridge for a 20min synthetic ramp during the canary window to validate warmup? that would let us potentially reduce credits if results are good. @northbridge-contact any chance?
northbridge-contact: we can run a 20min synthetic at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. happy to help.
maya: perfect. i'll enable canary and monitor. will attach post-toggle graphs to CS-5019.
rob: draft customer email template uploaded to draft folder with placeholders for breach windows and token counts. link: https://redwood.internal/cs/drafts/northbridge-provisional-credit (internal).
claire: assigning owners: rob (customer note + credit calc), evan (metrics + traces), maya (canary + infra logs), legal-bot (final provisional wording). i'll assemble bundle and send to legal for signoff before outreach.
rob: timeline: draft by 17:00 PST today.
claire: thanks all. closing loop: if canary + synthetic lower p95 below 160ms within 48h, we'll propose a reduced credit; otherwise proceed with standard provisional credit and comms. marking renewal risk as "at-risk - monitoring" and will update renewal tracker. :white_check_mark:
